62-year-old female (MRN SYN-2280247, weight 60 kg) with Hashimoto thyroiditis and primary hypothyroidism (diagnosed 2009), referred by Cardiology after developing new paroxysmal atrial fibrillation (ECG 2024-05-28 showing AF at 118 bpm; echocardiogram normal; started on metoprolol succinate 50 mg daily and apixaban 5 mg BID; HR 78 bpm and BP 126/74 mmHg on 2024-05-31) in the setting of exogenous T3 thyrotoxicosis on desiccated thyroid extract (Armour Thyroid 120 mg / 2 grains daily, stopped 2024-05-28). Labs on 2024-05-28 showed suppressed TSH 0.02 mIU/L (ref 0.4-4.5), elevated Free T3 6.4 pg/mL (ref 2.3-4.2), and normal Free T4 1.1 ng/dL (ref 0.9-1.7).
